baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive negation at لا يسأل attaches asking to عن ذنبه and distributes it over إنس ولا جان.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ordinary request-for-information is suspended precisely at culpability and across both named classes; the line removes interrogation without itself removing accountability.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting supplies the interrogative procedure negated by the passive verb.
Sin and culpable consequence specify the charged matter about which inquiry is withheld.
Visible human presence supplies one complete class covered by the distributive negation.
Hidden spirit beings supply the contrasting class equally covered by the negation.

changed_reading.before: No one is asked a question.
changed_reading.after: No visible or hidden creature is subjected to an information-gathering inquiry about culpability; accountability and interrogation are deliberately separated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated إنس ولا جان places a perception-associated root beside a concealment-associated root under one negated predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair functions not only as two populations but as an epistemic merism: what presents itself to awareness and what is screened from awareness are alike beyond interrogative recovery.

activation_trace.role: Questioning supplies the attempted route for acquiring an answer from either pole.
Perceiving something into awareness makes the human term the manifest or detectable pole of the pair.
Covering and concealment make the jann term the hidden pole reached by the same negation.

changed_reading.before: Humans and jinn are simply two species listed together.
changed_reading.after: The pair spans the manifest-hidden range, so the absence of questioning reaches beyond ordinary visibility rather than privileging what can already be perceived.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun ذنبه remains culpability while its tail and allotted-share branches remain visibly attached to the same focus word.
baseline_models.mechanism: The offense can be imaged as an aftermath trailing its doer and as a portion already attached to him; what follows the actor need not be reconstructed from his speech.

activation_trace.role: Sin and culpable consequence retain the ordinary juridical anchor of ذنبه.
The tail or rear-end image turns culpability into an aftermath that remains attached behind the actor.
The allotted-share image makes the trailing consequence a due portion rather than merely remembered information.
Negated asking removes verbal reconstruction from this attached-consequence mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Sin is an abstract topic about which testimony might be requested.
changed_reading.after: Sin is also an attached trail and due share carried by the actor, making the line image consequence as self-accompanying rather than confession-dependent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first carries universal creaturely asking directed toward Him, then appears as a negated passive directed toward no creature. The flow of speech reverses from need-bearing petition upward to a judgment that requires no evidentiary answer downward.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting make the earlier active يسأله a stream of creaturely petitions.
Fulfilling a request activates the answer-bearing possibility of the earlier asking relation.
The same asking image, now passive and negated, closes information-seeking from the judged creature.

structural_cues: 55:29 uses active يسأله with every inhabitant as asker; 55:39 uses passive لا يسأل with every human or jann as the unasked party.
كل يوم in 55:29 and فيومئذ in 55:39 sharpen the change as a temporal reversal rather than a lexical accident.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the active/passive reversal and asking/fulfilling branches; I infer a shift from petition to verdict. A live alternative is that 55:29 includes informational asking and the two scenes are only contrastive, not a procedural sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse merely announces silence at judgment.
changed_reading.after: It closes a prior economy of creaturely petition: needs once traveled upward as requests, but verdict no longer travels through answers extracted from creatures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from teaching the human disclosure by speech or sign to suspending questioning, then immediately identifies offenders by visible marks and seizes them. Communicative البيان is not denied; its forensic function is displaced from self-explanation to embodied indication.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure to a knower supplies the initial grant of intelligibility.
Revealing meaning by speech or sign supplies the human capacity whose forensic use is later bypassed.
Negated questioning marks the loss of solicited self-explanation at the focus point.
Recognition after an effect or sign supplies the alternative epistemic procedure immediately after the focus.
Offense and crime identify the recognized bodies as the bearers of the focus verse's culpability.
A visible mark that makes something known turns the body into legible evidence.
Being taken to account for an offense converts recognition directly into consequence without reported testimony.

structural_cues: The sequence is taught البيان in 55:4, no asking in 55:39, then passive recognition and seizure in 55:41.
Both 55:39 and 55:41 use passives, shifting attention away from a creature's authored account toward what is already manifest upon it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure by speech/sign, negated inquiry, recognition by marks, and taking for offense; I infer that marks replace solicited testimony. A live alternative is that the signs merely confirm knowledge acquired by an unmentioned route.

changed_reading.before: Not asking might suggest that expression or evidence has become irrelevant.
changed_reading.after: The mode of disclosure changes: taught verbal البيان yields, at judgment, to a البيان carried by the marked body itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early command to establish just measure and the later equation of act and recompense activate the focus's allotted-share branch of ذنب. The scene can therefore be procedural without being interrogative: consequence is calibrated and matched rather than negotiated through testimony.

activation_trace.role: The balance of justice supplies an impersonal standard for settling culpability.
Equity and fairness constrain the measure as just rather than merely automatic.
An allotted portion lets the focus offense carry an already-apportioned consequence.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the later reciprocal rule that completes the allocation image.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 repeatedly places and protects the measure; 55:39 omits inquiry; 55:60 formulates recompense as an act-for-act correspondence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies just measure, an allotted-share branch in ذنب, and matched recompense; I infer that these govern the no-question scene as calibrated settlement. A live alternative is that the balance concerns created order and commerce while 55:60 concerns reward only.

changed_reading.before: No questioning can sound like the absence of procedure.
changed_reading.after: The procedure may be metric rather than testimonial: a just, matched share follows the act without an interview.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring dual interrogation about denial occurs immediately before and after the focus line. Questioning has not vanished from the surah; it is relocated to the repeated present address, while the later culpability scene no longer solicits an individual account.

activation_trace.role: Attributing denial or falsehood supplies the charge posed to the paired audience immediately before the focus.
Negated asking distinguishes final inquiry from the refrain's ongoing rhetorical address.
Culpable offense links the refrain's denial charge to the unasked matter in the focus.
Falsehood or denial repeats immediately after the focus and seals the line inside an already voiced charge.

structural_cues: The identical second-person dual refrain in 55:38 and 55:40 brackets 55:39 exactly.
The refrain is interrogative in form, whereas 55:39 negates asking about a third-person singular offense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact bracketing and denial branches; I infer that rhetorical confrontation precedes and exposes the offense, leaving no later need for an evidentiary question. A live alternative is that the refrain is liturgical framing with no procedural chronology.

changed_reading.before: The line appears to deny questioning categorically.
changed_reading.after: It denies a later forensic interrogation while being enclosed by the question already addressed to both audiences; the opportunity for denial is voiced before the verdict scene.

context_deltas.mechanism: An announced turning toward the two weighty collectivities is followed by their explicit identification as jinn and humans, then by the same pair in the focus. This makes non-questioning concentrated encounter rather than divine inattention.

activation_trace.role: Turning intentionally toward an affair supplies concentrated address rather than vacancy.
Weight as the opposite of lightness makes the dual audience a consequential burden-bearing pair.
Hidden spirit beings identify one member of the previously dual address.
Visible human presence identifies the other member of that address.
The focus repeats the human member under distributive non-questioning.
The focus repeats the hidden member under the same non-questioning.

structural_cues: 55:31 addresses a dual الثقلان, 55:33 spells out الجن والإنس, and 55:39 repeats إنس ولا جان.
The focus occurs after the announced future turn toward them, so silence cannot straightforwardly mean that they are ignored.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intentional turning, weight, and the repeated pair; I infer that الثقلان is locally unpacked as humans and jinn and that no-questioning occurs under concentrated attention. A live alternative is that فرغ functions only as threat and says nothing about adjudicative attention.

changed_reading.before: No question could imply neglect or distance from the judged parties.
changed_reading.after: The silence occurs under an announced, concentrated turning toward the very two classes named; it intensifies encounter instead of weakening it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pair is challenged to pass beyond the cosmic bounds but cannot do so without compelling authority; after the focus, offenders are seized. The no-question interval closes both a spatial exit and an argumentative outlet: neither escape nor a demanded plea mediates the transition to capture.

activation_trace.role: Clean passage to the other side supplies the attempted spatial exit that the challenge blocks.
A compelling proof supplies the only imagined warrant for passage and also activates an argumentative outlet.
Negated questioning closes the solicited verbal outlet at the focus hinge.
Seizure and capture supply the terminal action after both outlets have closed.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats تنفذوا and لا تنفذون around the exception بسلطان; 55:39 negates asking; 55:41 moves directly to seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked passage, compelling authority, non-questioning, and capture; I infer a shared closure of physical and argumentative exits. A live alternative keeps سلطان purely as power and treats the legal-plea analogy as too strong.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns only whether information is requested.
changed_reading.after: It occupies the hinge where routes of evasion close: there is neither successful passage out nor a plea demanded before seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus names the concealed kind, the next scene defeats concealment by recognition from marks, and the later garden use of the same root turns covering into granted shelter. Concealment is not simply abolished; it is denied as opacity to judgment and restored as protection after judgment.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the latent property carried by the focus's jann term.
Hidden spirit beings keep the activation anchored to the actual focus referent.
Recognition by an effect or sign defeats concealment as an epistemic refuge.
The visible identifying mark externalizes what concealment could otherwise screen.
The tree-covered garden restores covering as bestowed shelter on the far side of recognition.

structural_cues: The root ج ن ن occurs as جان in the focus and as جنتان in 55:46 after the recognition-and-seizure scene.
The sequence runs hidden agent, visible marks, then covering garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the concealment, recognition, mark, and garden branches; I infer a redistribution from failed hiding to granted shelter. A live alternative treats جان and جنتان as ordinary polysemy with no designed transfer.

changed_reading.before: Naming the jann merely extends judgment to an otherwise hidden species.
changed_reading.after: At this hinge, hiddenness cannot prevent recognition; covering returns later not as evasion but as a bestowed garden-state.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant س ل ل mapping beneath a form ordinarily read from س ء ل, so it must not be rendered as a lexical retranslation. It remains anchored to the exact focus verb and gains mechanism from concealed jann plus immediately visible marks: interrogation can be carried as though it were an extraction of hidden content. Downstream prose should label it a split-root image or latent analogy, not the verse's surface sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb لا يسأل is the split-mapped site, and the object of inquiry lies beside the concealment-bearing جان.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary asking preserves the surface sense of interrogation that the outlier must not replace.
Gentle hidden drawing-out supplies the latent image of extracting a confession or concealed record.
Covering and concealment supply the hidden interior from which an answer might otherwise be drawn.
A visible identifying mark makes hidden extraction unnecessary by placing evidence on the surface.

changed_reading.before: No verbal question is put to the creature.
changed_reading.after: At the image layer, no confession has to be drawn out from concealment because culpability has already surfaced as a mark.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes ذنب through its physical tail branch and reads the next verse's forelock and feet as a body-axis; it is not a claim that ذنب literally means tail here. It remains valid as an anchored branch activation because the ordinary sin branch is retained and 55:41 immediately supplies bodily seizure. Downstream prose should present it as an imagistic consequence model, not philological disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The possessive ذنبه attaches the offense to the person just before criminals are seized by bodily parts.

activation_trace.role: Sin and culpable consequence retain the legal referent beneath the spatial image.
The tail or rear-end image turns the offense into a trailing attachment to its bearer.
Crime and offense identify the seized people with the culpability named in the focus.
The forelock and taking by it supply the leading end of the bodily capture image.
The foot that treads supplies the lower bodily end paired with the forelock.
Capture converts the front-to-trailing body image into an inescapable consequence mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Culpability is an abstract subject that could be described in an answer.
changed_reading.after: Culpability trails as an attached remainder, and the next scene catches the bearer bodily rather than recovering that remainder through speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links material branch images to communicative capacity: the packet states resonant dry clay, flame, and taught disclosure, but does not state that either material causes speech. It remains anchored to the focus's named human and jann under negated asking and preserves both creation references. Downstream prose should mark the causal connection as a cross-domain analogy, not an etymology or physical doctrine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same إنس and جان created through contrasted materials earlier are jointly placed under لا يسأل in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the communicative capacity explicitly taught to the human.
Resonance in a dry thing supplies an acoustic material image for the human's created medium.
A moving flame supplies the contrasting volatile material image for the jann's created medium.
Negated asking brings both created media to the same non-testimonial endpoint.
Visible human presence anchors the resonant-clay side to the actual focus subject.
Hidden spirit beings anchor the flame side to the other actual focus subject.

changed_reading.before: Two created classes happen not to be questioned.
changed_reading.after: The resonant human medium and volatile hidden medium converge in a judgment where neither creature's communicative production is solicited.

strongest_changes: The active petition of 55:29 reverses into the passive non-interrogation of 55:39: request flows upward, but verdict does not depend on an answer flowing downward.
Taught البيان gives way to recognition by embodied marks in 55:41, replacing solicited self-explanation with visible evidence.
The denial refrain asks the paired audience immediately before and after 55:39, relocating questioning from final investigation to prior rhetorical exposure.
Balance, allotted share, and matched recompense allow no-questioning to remain a just procedure rather than an absence of procedure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a hinge among several coexisting mechanisms: petition turns to verdict, speech turns to sign, measure turns act into share, concentrated attention needs no interview, and concealment changes from failed opacity to granted shelter. The split س ء ل/س ل ل inventory and the tail branch of ذنب also preserved image-level readings that a conservative audit would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant س ل ل mapping is productive as an extraction image but remains too form-distant to carry surface translation.
The justice-balance and recompense cues may govern the focus procedurally, or they may remain thematic analogies at different parts of the surah.
The transfer from hidden جان to covering جنتان may be a designed redistribution of concealment or simply ordinary polysemy.
The resonant-clay and flame convergence depends on a reader-supplied material-to-communication analogy and should remain explicitly exploratory.
